params.metadataCID: IPFS CID pointing to proof-of-farm documents
params.targetAmount: Total USDC the cooperative wants to raise

params.symbol_: Must match a registered oracle key (e.g. "hCOFFEE")
params.weightGrams: Pledged harvest weight in grams (e.g. 500_000 for 500 kg)

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

cancel(uint256).notice: Cancel an underfunded round after its deadline so token holders         can reclaim their principal from escrow.

createContract(string,string,uint256,uin.notice: Register a new harvest forward contract.

createContractByWeight(string,string,uin.notice: Same as createContract but derives targetAmount from weight × oracle price.

invest(uint256,uint256).notice: Buy hTOKENs with USDC. 1 USDC (1e6) = 1 hTOKEN (1e6).

oracles(string).notice: Admin registers a CropPriceOracle per crop symbol (e.g. "hCOFFEE").

redeem(uint256,uint256).notice: Burn hTOKENs and receive proportional USDC from the settled pool.

refund(uint256,uint256).notice: Return principal to a token holder when an underfunded round is cancelled.

requiredSettlement(uint256).notice: Principal plus the contract's fixed 12% repayment premium.

setOffTaker(uint256,address).notice: Set the buyer allowed to settle this forward contract.         The cooperative or pool owner must configure this before funding.

settle(uint256,uint256).notice: Pay the settlement amount in USDC after physical delivery.         Can be called in one or multiple tranches until fully settled.
